newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain bond yields to drop on foreign buying - Ferrer.
newsitem.headline: Spain bond yields to drop on foreign buying - Ferrer.

text.p: Spain's deputy director at the Treasury for foreign financing, Federico Ferrer, told RFTV in Tokyo on Wednesday that foreign investors buying into Spain would push Spanish yields yet lower.
"Investors are entering the Spanish market because they believe Spain is approaching monetary union and we share this belief. We don't see any reason why Spain can't be in in 1999," Ferrer said.
Ferrer said he expected the decline in Spanish long-term bond yields to continue, as foreign investors play an increasingly large role.

The final reduction in Spanish bond yields took place without the strong influence of non-residents and this makes us confident that there will be a second wave of purchases, this time from non-residents, Ferrer said.
